public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 相成门槛、三区入口与公众复核点
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Coevolution Threshold, three-area entries and public-review points
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 并列展示L7、D6、HOLD、责任角色、停止和修复状态
public_space_component_library.function_en: Displays L7, D6, HOLD, accountable roles, stop and repair state side by side
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 纸本状态牌、人工解释台与固定停止标识
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Paper status cards, staffed explanation desk and fixed stop signage
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 独立配重、不得占用盲道和树根区、可无损拆除
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: Freestanding ballast, clear of tactile routes and root zones, removable without damage

public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 错误广场与众智园试验链
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Error Square and the Zhongzhiyuan test chain
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 公开技术、责任与生态错误回执及再进入证据
public_space_component_library.function_en: Publishes technical, accountability and ecological failure receipts and re-entry evidence
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 纸本索引、人工借阅与现场申诉卡
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Paper index, staffed access and on-site appeal cards
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 可移动、可上锁、试验结束后移除并恢复铺地
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: Mobile and lockable; removed after a trial with surface restoration

public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 微扰日常居与AI原点社区服务点
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Low-Interference Everyday Home and AI Origin Community service points
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 提供安静、遮阴、真人优先且不强制屏幕的服务界面
public_space_component_library.function_en: Provides quiet, shaded, human-first service without mandatory screens
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 人工柜台、纸本、电话与固定低照明
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Staffed counter, paper, telephone and fixed low lighting
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 轻型可撤构架，不封闭普通路径，不连续遥测
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: Light removable frame that never blocks ordinary routes and performs no continuous telemetry

public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 三处地标、蓝绿节点与生态观察点
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Three landmarks, blue-green nodes and ecological observation points
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 展示空气、水、土壤、根系、阴影、暗夜安静和生物多样性基线
public_space_component_library.function_en: Shows baselines for air, water, soil, roots, shade, darkness/quiet and biodiversity
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 人工观察表、季节性样方与固定刻度
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Manual observation sheets, seasonal plots and fixed scales
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 不打桩穿根、不增加夜间发光、季末可撤
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: No root-piercing stakes or added night glow; removable at season end

public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 京张文明轴、错误广场与相成门槛
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Jing-Zhang civilizational axis, Error Square and Coevolution Threshold
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 并列记录贡献、失败修复、退役决定与具名责任，不只展示技术冠军
public_space_component_library.function_en: Records contribution, failure repair, retirement decisions and named accountability—not technology winners alone
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 可更换纸本卡、人工策展与无障碍口述版本
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Replaceable paper cards, human curation and an accessible spoken version
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 模块化挂接、年度复核、撤展后无痕恢复
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: Modular hanging, annual review and trace-free restoration after removal

public_space_component_library.spaces_zh: 十二个场景接触点与三区连续步行路径
public_space_component_library.spaces_en: Twelve scenario contacts and continuous walking routes across all three areas
public_space_component_library.function_zh: 明确无手机、拒绝数据或设备故障时的等价真人路径
public_space_component_library.function_en: Marks an equivalent human route for no-phone, data-refusal and device-failure conditions
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_zh: 固定导视、触觉标记、人工求助点与印刷地图
public_space_component_library.manual_ai_off_en: Fixed wayfinding, tactile marks, staffed help point and printed map
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_zh: 优先使用既有导视载体，不侵占净宽，可单件替换
public_space_component_library.installation_removal_en: Uses existing wayfinding carriers first, preserves clear width and allows piece-by-piece replacement

truth_boundary: No approval, site access, operator acceptance, funding, procurement, field result or professional signature is claimed.
